title: Implement word wrap in Go
description: Implement WordWrap(text string, maxWidth int) []string that breaks text into lines at word boundaries without exceeding maxWidth.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement WordWrap in wordwrap.go using strings.Fields:
- Split text into words
- Build current line; if adding next word (with space) exceeds maxWidth, flush line and start new one
- If current line is empty, add the word directly (handles words longer than maxWidth)
- Append remaining line at end
- Return empty slice for empty input
All 5 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
